readings.moment: At dinner, when everyone was asked to show their watches (after the temple bell struck nine)
While Madame and the doctor were playing piquet in the salon after dinner

durations: The interval from Dr Vauthier leaving the salon to fetch his cigars until his return, during which Madame played the piano (length not stated)
whereabouts: Madame's husband stood up and asked everyone at dinner to show their watches
Félix was at dinner, where his watch was shown
Aurèle was at dinner and scolded Félix in front of everyone
Monsieur Girard was at dinner and quarrelled with Madame's husband about the price of the repeater's rights
Madame and Dr Vauthier went into the salon after dinner
Madame and Dr Vauthier played piquet in the salon without a break
Dr Vauthier went out to fetch his cigars
Madame sat down at the piano at once when the doctor left and played until he came back
Madame stopped playing when Dr Vauthier came in
